newsitem.title: GERMANY: Domestic passenger drop hits Hamburg airport in 96.
newsitem.headline: Domestic passenger drop hits Hamburg airport in 96.

text.p: A fall in domestic air travellers caused a marginal decline of 0.1 percent to 8.2 million passengers at Hamburg airport (HAM) in 1996, airport authority Flughafen Hamburg GmbH said.
Domestic demand for German destinations fell 2.3 percent, a market research department report said.
Main growth destinations were the Mediterranean, Ireland, Canada and South Africa, it added.
Travel to eastern Europe and the Baltic States also increased.

Passenger numbers on scheduled services rose 10 percent to 6.97 million and fell on charter flights by 35.8 percent to 1.22 million since many holiday flights were now operated on a scheduled basis, the report said. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
